diagnostics.name: Backend verifier

items.text: Tanker Trackers reported that the oil spill in the Strait of Hormuz is likely due to the August 3 attack by the Islamic Republic on the ship Minuan Pioneer. The oil slick reached the Iranian shores after passing through the Strait of Hormuz. The Environmental Protection Organization also reported oil pollution on the coasts of Suza, Sheib Deraz, Naqasheh, and parts of Hengam Island.

Omid Sedighi, director of the Marine Pollution Office of the Environmental Protection Organization, announced that the coasts of Suza, Shibderaz, Naqasheh, and parts of Hengam Island have been affected by oil pollution. Cleanup operations are underway in these areas. The cause of the pollution is still unknown, and the cleanup is expected to be completed by the end of Wednesday.

Ali Akbar Javidan, the commander of the border police, called the claims about a possible ground attack on Iran delusional. He emphasized that Iran's borders are secure and enemy movements cannot undermine the country's security. He also referred to the armed forces' resilience during the war and mentioned that succession planning has been done.

Ata Hosseinian, an economic journalist, stated that the gasoline shortage and long queues at fuel stations are due to the naval blockade and the Islamic Republic's inability to import gasoline. He emphasized that this issue is not a consequence of war.

Amirhossein Bagheri Alavijeh, a master's student at Arak University and resident of Isfahan, remains in detention after 73 days. No indictment has been issued in his case so far. He is currently in a state of uncertainty.
Armed agents raided Mirabbas Khorshidvand's home on Tuesday, August 11, and arrested him. The arrest was reportedly due to his posts supporting his niece. His current detention location is unknown.

Iraj Khajeh Amiri, a veteran Iranian singer, passed away at the age of 93. He performed over two thousand songs and melodies in various programs. His career began in the 1950s with the program "Golha" and extended to film music.

The six-month financial report of Esteghlal Club shows it has over 4500 billion tomans in debt and nearly zero independent revenue. Ninety-seven percent of the club's budget and operating income depend on the Khalij Fars Holding. The club's operational cash flow was negative about 883 billion tomans during this period.

Since the beginning of 2026, at least 916 executions have been carried out in Iran, with 15 occurring in August. The actual number is likely higher as the government hides the statistics. Many protesters face serious charges and the risk of execution, with the sentencing process described as unfair and rushed.

Oil pollution observed on the southern coasts of Qeshm Island has spread to the mangrove forests in the village of Naqasheh. Monitoring and cleanup operations have begun to prevent further spread of the pollution. The exact source of the pollution is still under investigation.

Homa Teymouri and Yaser Azadeh, a couple arrested during the National Iranian Revolution, were each sentenced to five years in prison. Homa Teymouri was sentenced to five years in prison, two years of travel ban, and two years of social media ban for charges of gathering and colluding against national security. Her mobile phone will also be confiscated.

The Chinese passenger aircraft Comac C-919 will make its first international commercial flight on Wednesday, 21 Mordad. The flight will operate daily round trips from Beijing to Ulaanbaatar. This aircraft is China's first attempt to enter the large passenger aviation industry.

The Iranian Minister of Health said that India, in response to Iran's blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, did not send any raw materials for drug production to Iran even during the war. India made the shipment of pharmaceutical materials conditional on the passage of Indian-related ships through the Strait of Hormuz. These statements were made by Mohammadreza Zafarghandi.

Hossein Khajeh Amiri, the famous Iranian singer known as Iraj, passed away at the age of 94. His death revived memories of the golden era of music and cinema before the 1979 revolution. His voice is recognized as a standard in the history of Iranian singing.

As the 60-day ceasefire deadline approaches, regional mediators are trying to continue negotiations between Iran and the US. A senior Iranian official said no talks have taken place to extend the ceasefire. Donald Trump claimed that the US has full control over the Strait of Hormuz.

Images of expanding oil stains and residues on the shores of Qeshm have been published. Social media users have expressed concern about the environmental impact and effects on species such as green turtles and seabirds. Ayah Dris, a member of the Iran International editorial team, has commented on these reactions.

Mohammad Reza Naqdi stated that Iran's production capacity for ballistic missiles and drones exceeds their launch rate. The Islamic Republic has 950 industrial towns and hundreds of industrial complexes for producing these devices. He also said motivated forces can target US interests worldwide.

A survey by Iran International of 100,000 users shows that 83% are willing to migrate from Iran if conditions allow. Economic pressures and inability to meet basic needs are the main reasons for this desire. These results were reported by Seba Heidarkhani.

Al Hadath network reported that the Houthis affiliated with the Islamic Republic have buried 84 of their killed members over the past six days. Among them, 28 were commanders. This report was published on Wednesday, 21 Mordad.

The Gaza peace delegation denied reports of an agreement to pay $400 million of Hamas's debts. Nikolay Mladenov stated that Hamas will have no role in Gaza's administration or access to financial resources. He also called on Israel to approve the Gaza disarmament roadmap.

Masoud Pezeshkian met with Hossein Taeb, the new head of the Basij Organization, at a meeting of the Basij Medical Society's Think Tank. Pezeshkian described the current war as more complex than before and said the enemy seeks internal collapse of the country. Hossein Taeb has been appointed as the head of the Basij Organization.

Mohammadreza Mastaneh Saljouqi, a 66-year-old war veteran, has been detained since December 12, 2025, and remains in prison without access to a lawyer or judicial resolution. Due to chemical injuries and psychological issues, he is in a difficult condition and is restrained on a bed instead of receiving medical treatment when his condition worsens. This information was reported by Iran International.

The Canadian immigration ministry announced that letters have been sent to residency applicants with a history of service in the IRGC. These letters provide an opportunity to submit documents and defend their cases. The IRGC has been listed as a terrorist organization in Canada since 2018.

A video shows several Basij members mocking and harassing a young woman in the Sabzeh Meydan underpass in Isfahan due to her type of clothing. The woman was targeted after a warning about mandatory hijab. Baharan Azadi speaks about the government's violent behavior towards women with optional dress.

Flights at Catania airport in Italy were suspended on Wednesday, August 12, due to renewed ash emissions from Mount Etna. Aviation authorities extended airspace restrictions over eastern Sicily. Ash spread to the south also caused cancellations and delays of flights in Malta.

The US Secret Service carried out a deceptive operation last month to evacuate Donald Trump from Turkey. This operation was conducted after receiving a warning about a threat from the Islamic Republic against Trump. Details of the operation remained secret for weeks.

Cristiano Ronaldo reacted to the death of Jorge Messi, Lionel Messi's father, by wishing him strength and endurance on Instagram. Lionel Messi posted a picture of his father, expressing the difficulty of the loss and doubt about continuing football.

Amid the deadlock in Tehran-Washington talks, Mohammad Reza Naghdi said Mojtaba Khamenei has tasked the IRGC to prepare for operations on US and Israeli soil. Ghalibaf's advisor also warned that Trump and Netanyahu are secretly preparing for an insurgency in Iran alongside war.

Sara Khanmohammadi, sister of Mohammadmahdi Khanmohammadi, distributed food among the poor and decorated the place where he was shot in his memory. Mohammadmahdi was a 19-year-old from Karaj who was killed on January 8, 2026, while helping the wounded by a direct shot from behind.

Oman's Environment Authority announced that an oil spill caused by a ship accident has reached the southeast coasts of the country. The pollution may affect up to 40 kilometers of the Ras Madrakah coastline. Specialized teams are tracking and controlling the spill.

The war in the Middle East and the El Niño phenomenon have increased pressure on the Panama Canal. These conditions have raised the cost of ship passage and caused queues of ships. Ships are willing to pay higher fees to pass faster.

Boeing and Rheinmetall are cooperating to develop the MQ-28 Ghost Bat combat drone. This drone is designed for air-to-air and air-to-ground missions and is planned to be operational by 2029. Rheinmetall will integrate the system in Germany to retain the technology within the country's defense industry.

As the anniversary of Mahsa Amini's death approaches, pressure to impose hijab and restrict social freedoms in Iran has increased. Asieh Amini, a social analyst, said the Islamic Republic, after reducing external threats, has intensified pressure on people's dress and lifestyle.

People in various provinces of Iran complain about livelihood and service problems. In Bandar Abbas, electricity and water have been cut off, and in Tehran, traffic fines have increased. Additionally, issues such as poor school quality and internet disruptions have been reported.

Independent oversight is part of the minimum standards for the treatment of prisoners and must be independent from detention authorities. This oversight should be conducted unannounced and in all places of deprivation of liberty. Announced administrative visits cannot accurately reflect the real conditions of prisons.

Mohammad Reza Naqdi stated that the number of missiles produced by Iran exceeds those launched. He said that victory in the Iran war belongs to Iran and that Iran would be more dangerous without missiles. Naqdi also said that the Islamic Republic can control maritime routes considered threatening.

31 countries and the EU High Representative issued a joint statement condemning the execution of protesters and the use of the death penalty by the Islamic Republic. They called for an immediate end to executions and the release of arbitrarily detained individuals. They also urged the Islamic Republic to listen to the voices of the Iranian people and uphold human rights.

Amirhossein Roshanak announced that the Tehran derby between Esteghlal and Persepolis will likely be held on the 2nd or 3rd of September. The venue for the match is not yet determined, with several stadiums under consideration. Final scheduling will be done after the Asian competitions draw for Iranian representatives.

Two Democratic senators in the US have requested access to communications between immigration detention centers and Iranian diplomats. This request follows complaints from Iranian asylum seekers. The asylum seekers claim that the Department of Homeland Security shared their confidential information with Iran.

The director of Mocha port announced that the port's operations have been completely halted due to repeated attacks by the Houthis. In recent days, the port has been targeted multiple times by missile and drone attacks. Various parts of the port, including the dock and port equipment, have been damaged.

31 countries and the EU representative issued a joint statement condemning the execution of protesters in Iran. They called for an immediate end to the death penalty and the release of arbitrarily detained individuals. They also emphasized respect for freedom of expression and peaceful assembly.

Shaho Zirak, a 40-year-old welder, was arrested in Mashhad on the evening of Wednesday, August 12. The IRGC intelligence forces arrested him violently and transferred him to an unknown location. The arrest was due to his posts supporting the National Revolution and Prince Reza Pahlavi on social media.

Donald Trump said control of the Strait of Hormuz is in the hands of the United States. He described the leadership situation in Iran as "uncertain at best" and said Tehran cannot even pay its remaining forces. A senior Islamic Republic source told Reuters that "absolutely no progress" has been made in talks with the US.

Donald Trump confirmed changing planes during his return from Turkey. He said this decision was made on the recommendation of the US Secret Service. This was mentioned in an interview with Maryam Rahmati.

The Guardian reported that several sailors on the aircraft carrier Abraham Lincoln attempted to jump into the sea during its long mission. The carrier has been at sea for over 250 consecutive days, and families are concerned about the crew's mental health. The mission was redirected to the Middle East after the start of the war between the US and Israel with the Islamic Republic.

Alireza Namvar Haghighi said the Islamic Republic has underestimated the impact of economic sanctions and cooperation from China and India has been less than expected. China has disrupted Tehran's calculations about oil prices by reducing oil imports from Iran. He warned that if a solution to the economic crisis is not found by the end of the year, the country's economy will face difficulties.
Trump stated that the IRGC has been dismantled. He said the forces are fleeing. These remarks were made in the audio version of Titrawol with Niousha Saremi.

Mehdi Mahdavi Azad said the Caspian Sea regime convention is a "new Treaty of Turkmenchay" and Iran's share will decrease to less than five percent. He added that the Foreign Ministry and the Revolutionary Guards support the approval of this convention. Their support is due to fear of upsetting Putin.

Omar Artan, a referee from Somalia, became the first non-European referee to officiate the UEFA Super Cup match between Paris Saint-Germain and Aston Villa. He was unable to referee the 2026 World Cup due to US entry restrictions for Somali citizens. UEFA immediately appointed him as the referee for the UEFA Super Cup.

The uncle of Taha Soleimani announced the closure order of his store due to displaying a photo of his deceased nephew. He stated that having Taha's photo in the shop could result in six months to one year imprisonment. Taha Soleimani, 18 years old, was killed in Tehran by forces of the Islamic Republic.

Several nurses in Nishapur criticized the non-payment of their salaries and bonuses. They demanded that officials address their livelihood problems. This issue was raised in a report on nurses' wage demands.

The Deputy Coordinator of Urban Affairs of Kerman Province announced the start of gasoline sales at the refinery cost price of 87,200 tomans per liter at 204 fuel stations in Kerman. This non-subsidized sale began at midnight on Wednesday, August 12.
Amir Mohammad Rahimi, a 21-year-old from Mashhad, has been held in Vakilabad prison for about three months. No indictment has been issued for him yet. The exact charges against him are also unclear.

Vida Rabbani, a journalist and former political prisoner, accused her husband Hamidreza Amiri of domestic violence and forcibly taking her house, car, and jewelry. She stated that he used a power of attorney given during her imprisonment to seize her assets and even forged her signature to obtain a loan. Rabbani emphasized the need to break the silence about domestic violence.

Paris Saint-Germain defeated Aston Villa 2-1 to win the UEFA Super Cup for the second consecutive time. Kvaratskhelia and Doku scored for PSG, while Maja scored for Aston Villa. The winning goal was scored by Doku in the 61st minute.

Hossein Khajeh Amiri, a veteran traditional Iranian musician known as Iraj, passed away at the age of 94. He was a lasting voice in radio programs and learned musical radifs from his family. He was born in Isfahan and became a prominent singer remembered by many generations.

The manager of Kerman Oil Products Distribution Company announced that the sale of gasoline at refinery prices in Kerman province has been stopped. This decision was made after the governor of Kerman held talks with national officials. Further reviews are underway regarding the fuel consumption management and anti-smuggling plan.

Morad Vaisi, senior analyst at Iran International, reported a strategic rift at the top of the Islamic Republic between reconciliation leaders led by Pezeshkian and Qalibaf and confrontation leaders led by Mojtaba and some IRGC commanders. This conflict at the top of the system is expanding and deepening. He described this as a significant disagreement within the leadership of the Islamic Republic.

Donald Trump stated that Washington controls the naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz like a steel wall. These remarks came amid ongoing clashes and the naval blockade of Iranian ports. The Islamic Republic also emphasizes control over the Strait of Hormuz.

The 60-day ceasefire between Tehran and Washington under the Islamabad agreement will end in four days. Regional mediators are trying to continue negotiations. A senior Iranian official stated that no talks have taken place to extend the ceasefire.

Donald Trump announced that Caroline Lewitt will resign as White House spokesperson at the end of this month to spend more time with her family. After leaving the position, Lewitt will serve as a senior advisor outside the government. Trump praised her as one of the best White House spokespeople and appreciated her activities.

Morad Veysi said that Zolghadr's dismissal was due to his positive vote on the agreement in the Supreme National Security Council and not properly conveying Mojtaba's opposition to other members. This indicates serious disagreements between Mojtaba and Pezeshkian. With the appointment of Mohsen Rezaei, the divide at the top of the Islamic Republic has deepened.

In the program Politics with Murad Veisi, a severe disagreement between Mojtaba and Pezeshkian was discussed. The program covered the conflict between conciliationists and confrontationalists. The audio version of this program has been released.

Alireza Zakani stated that he went to the site of the attack on the Leader's residence by motorcycle. He spoke about the missile impact, Mojtaba Khamenei's location, his injury, and his concern while getting stitches. Mojtaba Khamenei was worried about missing his prayer.

General Steven Whiting stated that space has become a main domain of conflict. He warned that enemies of the US, including the Islamic Republic and China, target space infrastructure. Cooperation with allies and the private sector is important to counter these threats.

Esmail Baghayi, spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, pointed to the increasing marine pollution in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz, calling it an example of widespread pollution in the region. He mentioned the trillion-dollar damages to Iran's coastal areas and held energy-consuming countries, insurance companies, and military parties responsible. Baghayi emphasized that Iran cannot remain indifferent and that all benefiting parties are responsible for environmental damage restoration.

Journalists accompanying Donald Trump were unaware of a security operation and believed he was on the same plane. Trump secretly left Turkey on another military plane, and the plane's curtains were lowered by secret service orders. Trump acknowledged security concerns related to alleged threats from Iran but did not accept his direct role in the plane change.

Abdul El-Sayed, a Democratic Senate candidate from Michigan, has repeatedly defended Islamic Sharia law and stated his lifelong commitment to it. He confirmed this in a 2009 interview and requested that certain Islamic books not be filmed during his campaign. In 2022, he compared a Sharia ban proposal in Oklahoma to historical events in the state.

Current and former US officials told The Washington Post that the CIA did not find Israel's assessment of an immediate threat from the Islamic Republic against President Donald Trump convincing, but the Secret Service carried out an unprecedented security operation and secretly took him out of Turkey. The threat information was provided by Israel to the US, but CIA analysts assessed it as having 'low confidence'. However, to avoid any risk, the Secret Service moved Trump after the NATO meeting in Ankara secretly on another military plane to Britain.

Hamzeh Safavi stated that the Islamic Republic has plans for dirty bombs with radioactive materials to destroy Israel. He added that there is no guarantee that Iran's enriched uranium reserves are limited to the declared amounts. He also spoke about the global market for loose uranium and the vastness of Iran.

The United States said a permanent Israeli military presence in southern Lebanon is not consistent with its previous commitments and the goal of lasting peace and security. A US State Department official emphasized that Israeli forces staying in southern Lebanon contradicts Israel's prior assurances that it has no territorial ambitions toward Lebanon. The reaction came after Israeli Defense Minister Yisrael Katz said the Israeli army would remain in security zones in Lebanon, Syria and Gaza.

Officials of the Islamic Republic say the Strait of Hormuz remains closed and will not reopen until Tehran's conditions are accepted. The entity called 'Persian Gulf Waterway Management' stated that reopening the waterway is contingent on the acceptance of the Islamic Republic's conditions. According to data from Kepler, the five-day average of ship transits through the Strait of Hormuz has dropped to about 13 vessels per day.

The executive deputy of the Islamic Republic Army claimed that more than 75% of Iran's missile and drone capabilities remain intact and ready for use. He added that the production of defensive equipment has not stopped during the war. Foreign intelligence agencies have also confirmed this claim but have not provided any evidence.

Abbas Araghchi, Iran's foreign minister, criticized France on social media for its stance on human rights and international law. He accused France of hypocrisy and supporting Israel's genocide in Gaza. Araghchi emphasized that this support has destroyed any moral superiority France claimed to have.

American media reported that the decision to change Donald Trump's plane in Ankara was based on information about the entry of a shoulder-fired missile linked to the Islamic Republic into Turkey. Erfan Ghaneifard considered this operation a sign of Iran's serious intelligence weakness. He described the Islamic Republic as a criminal sect concerned only with its survival.

Shahram Khaledi pointed to the disagreement between Washington and Tel Aviv over Israel's military presence in southern Lebanon. The US does not want a halt or deadlock in negotiations to be an excuse for the Islamic Republic to open a new front against Israel or US allies. Israel is concerned about Hezbollah's tunnels and underground facilities in southern Lebanon.

A Hong Kong media report indicates expanding cooperation between China and the Islamic Republic in the field of rare earth elements. A group of Chinese researchers will travel to Iran to collaborate on exploration and processing of these elements. The report was published by Alireza Mohibi on Iran International.

Lionel Messi returned to the field four days after his father's death and played in Inter Miami's match against Club León. He entered the field in the second half and was warmly cheered by fans. Before the game, Messi paid tribute to his father on social media and expressed doubts about continuing his football career.

The chairman of the board of the Association of Air Conditioning System Manufacturers announced a 10 to 25 percent increase in the price of air conditioners. This price increase has led some consumers to choose fans and misting fans instead of air conditioners. The price increase varies depending on the brand and technical specifications.

The head of the judiciary in Khorramabad announced the issuance and implementation of alternative sentences to imprisonment for some defendants. The convicted are required to distribute livelihood aid packages, plant saplings, prepare entertainment packages, and distribute school supplies.

Kiavash Mirghasemi was killed on January 9th by direct gunfire from the suppressive forces of the Islamic Republic. This event remains in the memory of the Iranian people. His memory serves as a guiding light for freedom seekers.

A resident of the Darakeh neighborhood in Tehran reported noise pollution from a large cooling chiller installed in the local mosque's Hussainiya. Despite several follow-ups, no action has been taken to resolve the issue. This matter was reported to Iran International.

Anahita Zarei won the gold medal in the total category of the 77 kg weight class at the Asian youth weightlifting competition. Nasim Ghasemi also won gold and silver medals in the same category. Hasti Sedighi and Hanieh Sharifi earned gold and bronze medals respectively at the Asian junior championships.

The US stated that a permanent Israeli military presence in southern Lebanon is not compatible with Israel's previous commitments. The Israeli defense minister made remarks about the army's presence in southern Lebanon. Assessments in Israel indicate it is unlikely that Israel will withdraw from the areas it controls in southern Lebanon in the near future.
A citizen sent a video about the nighttime power outage in Sabzevar. He referred to a statement by Mohammad Reza Shah Pahlavi. The video was sent to Iran International.

A citizen in Baharestan was arrested by security police for writing a promotional comment against the regime on Instagram. A video of this person's forced confession has been released. The circumstances of the recording are unclear.

Mohammadreza Kanani, director general of Mazandaran environment protection, said the Caspian Sea water level has reached its lowest in about 200 years and is dropping 10 to 20 centimeters annually. He said over the past two decades the Caspian Sea water temperature has risen by about one and a half degrees and evaporation has increased by 10 to 15 percent, and the increase in temperature and evaporation has caused the Caspian water balance to become negative. He warned that continued decline of the Caspian Sea water level could affect the livelihoods of coastal communities, coastal facilities and infrastructure, and ecosystems dependent on the Caspian, including coastal wetlands.

The pilot plan to sell gasoline at 87,000 tomans in Kerman has been stopped due to concerns about public protests. This was announced by a manager of fuel stations. Additionally, a member of Iran International's editorial team reported on citizens' reactions to the plan.

Shahab Mohammadi, a citizen from Izeh, was arrested 191 days ago in connection with the December 2025 protests and remains detained in Sheiban prison in Ahvaz. He is in a state of judicial uncertainty, and his family has been unable to secure bail for his temporary release. Since February 11 last year, he has been held in ward 6 of Sheiban prison and has been denied visits with his family.

Voters in the Clacton constituency in eastern England are participating in a by-election today. This election is held following the voluntary resignation of Nigel Farage from his seat. More details are provided by Ali Rashid.

The German government has approved a new plan to expand the operational and cyber authorities of its intelligence services. This plan will transform the German foreign intelligence agency from an information analysis body into an operational organization. The plan requires parliamentary approval.

Arian Karapet, an Iranian-Armenian member of the Swedish parliament, stated that the Sweden Democrats party plans to close the Iranian embassy and its espionage centers if they join the next government. He has spoken in parliament about the threats posed by the Islamic Republic and espionage against citizens. His invitation to Reza Pahlavi was a result of protest gatherings.

Mohammad Javad Akbarin stated that the new threats by Islamic Republic figures against the region lack legal validity. He emphasized that these threats should be taken seriously in practice. Akbarin warned that these threats cannot be dismissed merely as psychological warfare.

Sohrab Bakhtiarizadeh, head coach of Esteghlal, criticized some players for prioritizing money and their agents over the club's jersey and fans. He cited this as a reason for Esteghlal's limited transfer activity. He also mentioned that Esteghlal has become an almost industrial team due to the mindset of some agents and players.

The 26th season of the Iranian Premier Football League is starting. Despite the economic crisis caused by the war, Iranian clubs have spent heavily in the transfer market. Mozdak Mirzayi has provided explanations about the billion-dollar expenses in the league.

Abbas Araghchi, Iran's foreign minister, accused the signatories of the EU and 32 other countries' statement against the execution of protesters in Iran of preaching about human rights. He said these countries lost their moral superiority due to supporting attacks on the Islamic Republic. These remarks were made in an interview with an Iran International reporter.

Amin Masouri, a writer and researcher, was arrested on Sunday, 18 Mordad, to serve his prison sentence and was transferred to Khorramabad prison. This news was reported by the HRANA news agency. His prison sentence has been enforced.

Sohrab Bakhtiarizadeh spoke about Ramin Rezaeian's departure from Esteghlal and said he wished Rezaeian had returned to the team but his requested fee was high. He also emphasized that Rezaeian's absence is difficult for the team and he would have been happy if he had come. Bakhtiarizadeh wished Rezaeian success.

Parsa Najafi, a Bahá'í citizen residing in Isfahan, has been held in custody at Dastgerd Prison in Isfahan for over two months without a clear decision. He has not had any visits for 45 days, and his lawyer has not been able to access his case. He has only had a brief phone call with his family recently.

Mehdi Mahmoudian was sentenced to eight months in prison for propaganda against the regime. He did not attend the court and did not appeal the sentence, considering this a form of protest. Mahmoudian announced he has another case with the same charge and will not attend that court either.

The 2026 World Equestrian Championship began with an opening ceremony in Aachen, Germany. This competition is the first stage for qualifying for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympic and Paralympic Games. The report was provided by Farbod Sarvandi from Iran International.

Ali Al-Zaidi, the Prime Minister of Iraq, has stated that efforts to disarm militias supported by the Islamic Republic have increased. He emphasized that Iraq's territory will not be allowed to become a platform for attacks on neighboring countries. This was reported by Troska Sadeghi, a journalist from Iran International.
